subject: infoschema: change infoschem v2 btree element from tableItem to *tableItem (#58324)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent in `pkg/infoschema/{infoschema_v2.go,builder.go,infoschema_v2_test.go}`. Change is a mechanical switch of infoschema v2’s `byName`/`byID` BTree element type from `tableItem` (value) to `*tableItem` (pointer), with corresponding updates to `add/remove/reset/search` and iteration paths. Checked key callers (`TableByID`, `TableByName`, `IterateAllTableItems`, `SchemaSimpleTableInfos`) to ensure no mutation of returned `*tableItem` occurs (which would risk BTree ordering corruption) and confirmed usage is read-only. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata consistency, or concurrency/visibility handling for the touched infoschema v2 paths.
